sources.fact: Current authoritative Brownfield entity is LBBD67/DJ, Clockhouse Avenue.
Current minimum and maximum net dwellings are both 250 on 0.74ha.
The record states the site is part permissioned for 59 homes.
Structured status is permissioned with full-planning-permission dated 28 October 2022.
The current record marks the site deliverable.
Ownership-status is owned-by-a-public-authority; this is not a current named proprietor/title relation.
The record supplies a point and blank geometry, not exact subsite or title polygons.
Regulation 19 HTML identifies DJ Clockhouse Avenue as a Local Plan allocation attachment.
Regulation 19 approval is plan-making provenance, not a 250-home site permission.
21/00159/FULL at 34-42 East Street was a distinct 79-home proposal within the wider emerging allocation and was refused; it is not the 59-home permissioned subsite.
2015 regeneration minutes identify Clockhouse Avenue/Broadway as a wider town-centre scheme context, not exact parcel permission.
No exact polygon binding the 59-home permission, remaining 191 capacity and HMLR titles was verified this wave.

examples.result: DJ retains 250 dwellings as current capacity.
Only 59 homes are explicitly described as part permissioned.
The refused 79-home East Street case is not substituted for the 59-home subsite.
Regeneration-area references are not exact parcel boundaries.
Public-authority ownership category is not current proprietor proof.
The Brownfield point is not converted into title geometry.
Promotion remains zero until exact subsite, decision and title topology are verified.
